copy.h1: A Disney kid built a $1.3 billion makeup brand. We followed the money.

summary.t: A former stage actress who moved with Selena to Los Angeles in 2007. She cofounded the mental health startup Wondermind with her daughter in 2021.

owns.t: Cofounder. She reportedly borrowed against her home to keep it going in 2025.

summary.t: Mandy’s husband. He managed Selena’s career until 2014.
A former Disney Channel star turned singer, actress and producer. Most of her fortune is her stake in Rare Beauty, the makeup company she launched in 2020.

owns.t: Founder; owns at least 51%, Forbes estimates.

record.t: Bloomberg called her a billionaire in September 2024. Forbes puts her at about $700 million: it values Rare Beauty at $1.3 billion and her stake at at least 51%, plus about $90 million in pre-tax earnings from TV, music, tours and endorsements.
In March 2024 Bloomberg reported she had hired advisers to field investor interest in Rare Beauty. Business of Fashion said a deal could value it at $2 billion. No sale was announced.

The startup raised $5 million at a $100 million valuation in 2022. In May 2025 it missed payroll and laid off nine employees, leaving four. She and her mother had put in $8 million of their own money by mid-2023.

facts.t: Rare Beauty had $367 million in revenue in 2023, according to a California state filing.
She reportedly made $30 million from a 2017 Puma deal and about $24 million from Only Murders in the Building.
One percent of Rare Beauty’s sales go to the Rare Impact Fund, which aims to raise $100 million for mental health over ten years.

summary.t: A music producer and songwriter. They announced their engagement in December 2024 and married on Sept. 27, 2025, in the Santa Barbara area.

record.t: The same week they got engaged, they closed on a $35 million Beverly Hills house from film director Todd Phillips.
